content: Ɩlɔ Pɛpɛ Ɔlɔpʋ́ Ɔkʋ Tsa
Brɛ́á Yesu lɛ́kplɩ́ tsú ɩbʋ ámʋsʋ á, ɔdɔm kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ bobuo mʋ.
Ɩnʋ á, ɩlɔ pɛpɛ ɔlɔpʋ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba bɛda akpawunu mʋ ayabitɔ, kókóli mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé! Nɩ́ fótsulá á, fɛ́talɩ́ há mɩ́ ɩwɩ bɛ́plɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́tɩnkɩ́ ɩbɩ da mʋ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Natsúlá, fʋ́ ɩwɩ ɩplɩ́ɩ!” Ɩnʋnʋ mʋ ɩwɩ lɛ́plɩ.

Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́da mʋ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mábla ɔhaa asʋ́n ánfɩ. Natɩ laa afʋpʋ fʋ́ ɩwɩ yosuná Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́, afʋha mʋ ɩwɩgyʋrátɔ amʋ́ʋ́ Mose mbla losuná tsú ɩlɔ pɛpɛtsa ɩwɩ ámʋ. Igyi adánsɩɛ suna ahá ánɩ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩ laplɩ́ɩ.”
Romafɔ Ɩsá Akɔpʋ́ Ɔhandɛ Osúmpʋ́ Ɔkʋ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Yesu lówie Kapernaum wúlutɔ. Romafɔ ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba mʋ wá, bóbwií ɩpa há mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Owíé, mɩ́ osúmpʋ́ dɛ́lɔ. Alasin tsukʋlɛ, ɔda wóyítɔ́ ɔdɛ ɩwɩɔsɩn wúun dʋbɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɛ́ba bɛtsa mʋ ɩlɔ.”

Támɛ ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, mmɔfʋn ánɩ́ fɛ́ba mɩ́ wóyítɔ́. Fʋ́ mʋ́ blɩ asʋankʋ, ɩwɩ bɔ́wa mɩ́ osúmpʋ́ amʋ ɔnlɩn. Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́ ɛ́ mbʋ ahandɛ akʋ asɩ, ɩsá akɔpʋ́ akʋ ɛ́ bʋbʋ mɩ́ asɩ. Nɛlɛ́ ɔnɔ́ mbɛ́ɛ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋ ɔnátɩ á, ɔtɛnátɩ́. Nɩ́ mbɛ́ɛ ɔbá ɛ́ á, ɔtɛba. Tógyítɔ́á nɛbláa mɩ́ osúmpʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ ɔbwɛ́ɛ á, ɔtɔbwɛ́.”

Brɛ́á Yesu lónu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, ɔnɔ́ lobwie mʋ, ɔlɛdamlí bláa ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbuo mʋ amʋ, ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mmɔkʋ́wun ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbʋ hógyi kpɔnkpɔntɩ ánfɩ odu Israelfɔtɔ kʋ́ráá kɩ!”
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, “Ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bótsu owí ɔdalɩkpa pʋ́ owí ɔkplɩ́wíékpá ba, betsiá atɔ́ ogyíkpá Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ, amʋ́a anɩ anáin Abraham, Isak pʋ́ Yakob aná bɔ́wa ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́.
Támɛ bɛ́lɛ Israelfɔ ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ bʋgyi Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ atsiápʋ́ amʋ lɛ́ ɩnʋ, tswɩ amʋ́ wá oklúntɔ. Ɩnʋ́ isú mʋ́a kpisíi bʋ nɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlabláa ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Natɩ, ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́ ha fʋ fʋ́ hógyi ɔnɔ́.” Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ pɛ́pɛ́ɛ́pɛ́ osúmpʋ́ amʋ ɩwɩ lɔ́wa mʋ ɔnlɩn.
Alɔpʋ Tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ Tsa
Yesu lɔ́yɔ Petro wóyítɔ́. Ɔlɔyɔ á, owísó lakɩ́tá Petro mʋ sia tsɩ́hɛ́, ɔda.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛyɛ́kɩtá ɔtsɩ ámʋ ɩbɩ. Ɩnʋnʋ owísó amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ mʋsʋ, ɔlɔbwɛ Yesu afɔɔ́tɔ.
Mʋ́ ntʋ́pwɛsʋ á, bɔpʋ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔá ɔŋɛ laláhɛ dɛ́ amʋ́ háan ba Yesu. Ɔlɔtɔɩ́ gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ, tsá alɔpʋ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́.
Ɩ́nɩ lɛ́ha asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́Yesaia lɛ́blɩ́ ámʋ lɛba mʋ́tɔ́. Ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋlɛ́tsa anɩ ɩlɔ, tsú ipian kʋ́sʋ́ anɩsʋ.”
Ahá Ánɩ́ Bɛɛ Bɔ́bwɛ Yesu Abúopʋ
Yesu lówun ánɩ́ ɔdɔm babomlí mʋ, ɔlɛbláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩha afa Galilea ɔpʋ yɔ mʋ́ ɔbɩn.”
Ɩnʋ Mose mbla osunápʋ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́bá mʋ wá, bɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́, nóbuo fʋ yɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á fɔ́yɔ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Awɩá bʋbʋ mbɔ́, mbubwi ɛ́ bʋbʋ asia, támɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ mʋ́ mma ɔtɩ́nɛ́á nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ nwun tswɩ.”
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbuo mʋ amʋtɔ ɔkʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, ha mɩ́ anyopulá mɩ́ sɩ́ asa ambobuo fʋ.”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bobuo mɩ, afʋsi awupʋ́ abʋpula amʋ́ afúli.”
Atsufú Asɩbá
Yesu lówie ɔklʋntɔ, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɛ́ bowie buo mʋ.
Brɛ́á bɔyɔ́ á, afú kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ kʋ lɔ́wa tsʋ́ʋn bɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ ntsu dɛda wíé ɔklʋn amʋtɔ, ideklé ɩmɛ, támɛ Yesu mʋ́ da ɔdɛdɩdɩ.
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ betsinkí mʋ, bláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe lɛ anɩ. Anɩdɛ́ ntsu wie!”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ ifú nya alɩ? Mlɩ hógyi mɔtsɔ́!” Ɩnʋ ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ lɛ́ ɔnɔ́ wa afú mʋ́a ntsu ámʋ, ɩnʋ fɛ́ɛ́ lɔlʋá.
Ifú lɛhɩɛ kɩ́tá amʋ́, bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Nyankpʋsa ɔmɔmʋ nɩ, afú mʋ́a ntsu kʋ́ráá tonú mʋ ɔmɛ alɩ?”
Ɔŋɛ Laláhɛ Gyáa Lɛ Agbedépʋ́ Abanyɔ́tɔ́
Brɛ́á Yesu lówie Galilea ɔpʋ ɔbɩn, Gadarafɔ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ á, ayin abanyɔ́ akʋá ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ amʋ́tɔ́ bɛdalɩ tsu afúli opulákpá befia mʋ. Amʋ́ ɩyɩn sʋ ɔhaa tamatálɩ́ tsʋn ɔkpa ámʋsʋ.
Ɩnʋnʋ bɔkplʋ́n fɩtɛ́ Yesu bɛɛ, “Bulu mʋ Bi, amansʋ igyi? Fɛbá bɛpɩtɩ́ anɩ atɔ́ asa Bulu ɩsʋbɩtɩ́bɩ ɩfʋn?”
Mprákuo tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ akʋ bʋdegyí ɩnʋ fʋ́n.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ bokokóli Yesu bɛɛ, “Nɩ́ fégya anɩ lɛ́ ahá ánfɩtɔ á, ha ayowie mprákuo ánfɩtɔ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyɔ.” Ɩnʋnʋ bɛdalɩ ayin ámʋtɔ yówie mprákuo ámʋtɔ. Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛsrɩ́ kplɩ́ okúku kʋ wíé ɔpʋ amʋtɔ, wúwu.
Mprákuo ámʋ akpapʋ́ bɛsrɩ́ yɔ́ wúlutɔ, yɛ́bláa ahá tógyítɔ́á ɩlaba ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ amʋ́tɔ́ ámʋsʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ wúlu amʋtɔ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ bɛdalɩ ba Yesu wá. Brɛ́á bowun mʋ a, bokokóli mʋ bɛɛ, ɔdálɩ amʋ́ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ.
